title: Knowledge base
description: Articles used by the help center and in AI agent answers. Drafts stay invisible until published; every save creates a new version.
forbidden: You do not have permission to view the knowledge base.
error.title: Could not load the knowledge base
error.description: Check your connection and try again.
toast.failed: The action could not be completed. Try again.
slug_hint: Shown in the address. Use lowercase letters, digits and hyphens.
slug_invalid: Only lowercase letters (a-z), digits and single hyphens; it cannot start or end with a hyphen.
articles.empty_description: Write frequently asked questions and solution steps as articles. Published public articles appear in the help center and the widget.
fields.title: Title
fields.body_placeholder: Write the article. Headings, lists, code, quotes, tables, images and links are supported.
fields.name: Name
visibility.public_hint: Once published it is used in the help center, the widget and customer-facing AI answers.
visibility.internal_hint: Only your team and the AI agent see it; it is never published in the help center.
feedback.title: "Was this helpful?" votes from the help center
tags.placeholder: Type a tag and press Enter
collections.description: Collections are the main sections of the help center; categories sit under a collection. A collection that still has articles or categories cannot be deleted.
collections.collection_hint: Shown as a card on the help center home page.
collections.category_hint: Groups articles under a collection. Its collection cannot be changed later.
collections.conflict: This address is already in use, or the kind and collection cannot be changed.
collections.invalid: The name or address is invalid.
collections.delete_conflict: This collection still has articles or categories. Move or delete them first.
collections.empty_description: Create a collection to group articles by topic (e.g. Billing, Account, Integrations).
editor.invalid: The title, address or tags are invalid.
editor.conflict_description: A newer version of this article was saved while you were editing, or the address of a published article was changed. Load the latest version so nothing is overwritten; copy any text you want to keep first.
editor.slug_locked: The address of a published article cannot change, so old links and AI citations keep working.
editor.confirm_delete_description: The article is unpublished and removed from the list. This cannot be undone.
versions.title: Version history
versions.restore: Restore version v{{version}} into the draft
versions.restored: v{{version}} loaded into the draft. Save to keep it.
audience.title: Who sees it
audience.everyone: No conditions: the widget suggests the article to everyone.
audience.targeted: The widget suggests the article only to contacts that match every condition. Saving applies at once.
history.description: Turn your past support records (an export file) and the conversations you close every night into knowledge. Records are anonymized on the server, kept in a read-only archive and never appear in the inbox. A suggestion appears once enough cases share the same resolution; an approved suggestion becomes an article draft.
history.consent_analysis: As the owner of these records, I consent to ClickFix analyzing them and producing knowledge suggestions. (Required)
history.consent_training: Anonymized records may also be used to train models. (Optional, recorded separately)
history.privacy_note: Names, phone numbers, e-mail addresses, tax numbers, addresses and company names are removed before anything reaches the AI provider. The raw file is deleted when the run ends.
history.uploaded: File received; the run is queued.
history.empty_description: Upload an export file or turn on the nightly run.
history.rollback_description: The cases this run added to the archive and the pending suggestions only they support are deleted. Approved suggestions and the decision memory stay.
history.counts: {{processed}}/{{total}} records processed, {{skipped}} skipped · {{suggestions}} suggestions, {{suppressed}} suppressed by the decision memory
history.suggestions_empty_description: A suggestion appears here once the same resolution is seen in as many cases as the evidence threshold.
history.conflict: Very close to the published article "{{title}}"; compare the two.
history.review_description: Your decision is kept with its reason. A rejected suggestion does not come back in a similar form; an approved one becomes an internal article draft.
history.decided.approve: Suggestion approved; an article draft was created.
history.decided.correct: Corrected suggestion approved; an article draft was created.
history.decided.reject: Suggestion rejected and added to the decision memory.
history.reason_placeholder: For example: this issue is gone since the new release
history.hint.evidence_threshold: Minimum number of cases that must share a resolution before a suggestion.
history.hint.cluster_similarity: Similarity two cases need to join the same group (0.5–0.99).
history.hint.resolution_similarity: Similarity two resolutions need to count as the same.
history.hint.rejection_similarity: A draft this close to a rejected suggestion is not suggested.
history.hint.raw_retention_hours: The raw file is deleted when the run ends, at the latest after this long if a run is stuck.
history.nightly: Also process conversations closed each night
history.nightly_consent_analysis: As an organization we consent to our own conversations being analyzed. (Required for the nightly run)
department_hint: A department's article is seen by that department (and departments it is shared with); organization-wide articles apply everywhere.
